method: Human-model manual comparison of description, title and extracted fields: fixed first 10 historical and first 10 live pilot rows; source text and complete outputs in pilot.json. No independent LLM grader used. Literal grounding and schema are separately checked by code.
decision: Proceed for descriptive skill/AI mention analysis with explicit caveats; not a validated census of mandatory skills or precise role/context categories. No manual overrides were applied to model outputs.
limitations: Small convenience review sample, not an accuracy confidence interval
Alternative/example skills are often over-labeled required
One clear coarse-role error; some AI-context and seniority ambiguity
Experience alternatives and preferred ranges require reading evidence
Currency and salary period deliberately remain unknown without explicit support
